name: Déclaration de nationalité par mariage

requirement_groups.name: Residing in France at the time of declaration

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 4 years of marriage to a French citizen, with the couple residing in France.
This requires French at CEFR B2, same standard as the general naturalisation route since 1 January 2026.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass an approved test at B2.

requirement_groups.name: Residing outside France at the time of declaration

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 5 years of marriage to a French citizen when the couple has not been continuously resident in France.
This requires French at CEFR B2.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass an approved test at B2.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate, transcribed in France where the marriage took place abroad
TCF IRN or DELF B2 certificate covering all four language skills
Evidence of continued cohabitation/community of life throughout the marriage

sources.title: Légifrance — Code civil Art. 21-2 (déclaration de nationalité par mariage)
Légifrance — Décret n° 2025-648 du 15 juillet 2025 (B2 language level, applies to marriage-based declarations too)

notes: The B2 language reform (see fr_naturalisation) applies EQUALLY to this marriage-based route, not just the general naturalisation-by-decree route — a genuine and easily-missed scope point, since several jurisdictions in this dataset (e.g. Germany, Portugal) give marriage-based citizenship an EASIER language standard than the general route, while France now applies the same B2 bar to both. This is a declaration-based procedure (the applicant asserts a right and the state can only refuse on narrow specified grounds) rather than a purely discretionary decree, procedurally distinct from fr_naturalisation even though the outcome is the same French citizenship. prerequisites here point at fr_regroupement_familial's family-of-French-citizen group specifically, closing the loop between that route's citizenship_after_months (48, i.e. 4 years) and this route's own 4-year marriage-duration requirement for France-resident couples — the two figures are meant to align, confirming internal consistency across the dataset's France routes.
